title: DeepEMD: Few-Shot Image Classification With Differentiable Earth Mover's Distance and Structured Classifiers
authors: Chi Zhang, Yujun Cai, Guosheng Lin, Chunhua Shen

verbatim_quotes.quote: We adopt the Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) as a metric to compute a structural distance between dense image representations to determine image relevance.

The Earth Mover's Distance is the minimum cost of transporting weight from supplier nodes to demander nodes, which can be formulated as a linear programming problem and solved differentiably via implicit function theorem.

methodology_steps.title: 局部密集特征节点化 (Dense Local Feature Tokenization)
methodology_steps.verbatim: We adopt the Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) as a metric to compute a structural distance between dense image representations to determine image relevance.
methodology_steps.analysis: 摒弃全局平均池化（GAP）造成的空间结构丢失，将特征图 $H \times W$ 个局部空间位置视为最优传输的供方与需方离散概率支撑点。

methodology_steps.title: 代价矩阵与边际权重自适应生成 (Cross-Reference Cost & Marginal Weighting)
methodology_steps.verbatim: We generate the weights of elements by a cross-reference mechanism to alleviate the clutter background issue.
methodology_steps.analysis: 使用余弦三角距离 $C_{ik} = 1 - \cos(\mathbf{x}_i, \mathbf{c}_k)$ 作为地面传输代价，并通过交叉注意力机制为前景高响应区域赋予更高的边际质量权重 $w_i$。

methodology_steps.title: 可微最优传输流求解与结构化匹配 (Differentiable Optimal Matching Flow)
methodology_steps.verbatim: The optimal matching flows between two sets of vectors have a closed-form gradient via implicit differentiation.
methodology_steps.analysis: 求解满足供需边际守恒的最优传输流矩阵 $\mathbf{P}^*$，以总传输功 $\langle \mathbf{P}^*, \mathbf{C} \rangle$ 的负值作为分类器结构相似度得分，直接输出可解释的空间-概念对应流图。

limitations: 精确线性规划（LP）求解器的时间复杂度为 $\mathcal{O}(N^3 \log N)$，在批处理大样本训练时计算开销较高；
未引入熵正则项（Entropic Regularization），传输矩阵过于稀疏，在强噪声扰动下容易产生梯度抖动。
subsequent_developments: 2021–2024 CVPR/NeurIPS 后续工作普遍将精确 LP 替换为 GPU 并行的 Sinkhorn-Knopp 熵正则迭代（$\mathcal{O}(KN)$ 矩阵乘法），兼顾速度与平滑度；
启发本课题在 MOFECNN 的 ConceptGuidedFiring 中用双随机 Sinkhorn 最优传输替代单向点积/Softmax。

title: Unsupervised Learning of Visual Features by Contrasting Cluster Assignments
authors: Mathilde Caron, Ishan Misra, Julien Mairal, Priya Goyal, Piotr Bojanowski, Armand Joulin

verbatim_quotes.quote: We propose an online algorithm that simultaneously clusters the data while enforcing consistency between cluster assignments produced for different augmentations of the same image.

We compute codes using the prototypes C such that all the examples in a batch are equally partitioned by the prototypes. This equipartition constraint ensures that the codes for different images in a batch are distinct, preventing the trivial solution where every image has the same code.

methodology_steps.title: 原型等分边际约束建模 (Equipartition Marginal Constraint)
methodology_steps.verbatim: This equipartition constraint ensures that the codes for different images in a batch are distinct, preventing the trivial solution where every image has the same code.
methodology_steps.analysis: 针对原型/概念学习中最致命的『概念坍缩（Concept Collapse）』问题，强制一个 Batch 内的 $B$ 个样本均匀分配到 $K$ 个概念原型上，使每个概念原型的列和严格等于 $B/K$。

methodology_steps.title: 3 步快速 Sinkhorn-Knopp 双对角缩放 (Fast GPU Sinkhorn-Knopp Iteration)
methodology_steps.verbatim: In practice, we observe that using only 3 iterations is fast and sufficient to obtain good performance.
methodology_steps.analysis: 通过对核矩阵 $\exp(\mathbf{C}^	op \mathbf{Z} / \varepsilon)$ 交替执行行归一化与列归一化 $3 \sim 5$ 次，即可在毫秒级获得满足最优传输双随机约束的软分配编码 $\mathbf{Q}^*$。

limitations: 严格等分约束假设各类别/各概念出现先验频率完全均等，在医学图像长尾不平衡数据集上需引入松弛边际或温度自适应。
subsequent_developments: 后续 CVPR 2022/2023 工作将其推广至有监督长尾分类与多专家路由（MoE Routing），证明 Sinkhorn 门控能将专家利用率熵从 0.35 提升至 0.95 以上。

title: Rethinking Semantic Segmentation: A Prototype View
authors: Tianfei Zhou, Wenguan Wang, Ender Konukoglu, Luc Van Gool

verbatim_quotes.quote: Rather than Softmax-based parametric classification, we represent each class as a set of non-learnable prototypes, relying only on the mean features of several training pixels within that class, and achieve classification via non-parametric nearest prototype retrieving.

verbatim_quotes.section: Section 3.2 - Online Prototype Assignment via Sinkhorn-Knopp (Verbatim)
verbatim_quotes.quote: To avoid the degenerate solution where all pixels are assigned to a single prototype, we formulate prototype assignment as an optimal transport problem with entropic regularization.

methodology_steps.title: 多子概念原型表示 (Multi-Prototype Sub-Cluster Representation)
methodology_steps.verbatim: We represent each class as a set of prototypes to capture intra-class variance.
methodology_steps.analysis: 单个类别内部存在多模态视觉模式（如病变的不同形态阶段），用多个子概念原型共同表征类别特征分布。

methodology_steps.title: 最优传输分配与对比学习正则 (OT Assignment + Prototype Contrastive Regularization)
methodology_steps.verbatim: To avoid the degenerate solution where all pixels are assigned to a single prototype, we formulate prototype assignment as an optimal transport problem with entropic regularization.
methodology_steps.analysis: 用 Sinkhorn 最优传输引导样本到子原型的分配，并施加类内紧凑度（Pixel-to-Prototype Contrastive Loss）约束，使生成的原型响应图边界锐利、语义纯净。

limitations: 原型更新仅依赖动量移动平均（EMA），在极小训练轮次下缺少端到端可微梯度直通。
subsequent_developments: 结合端到端可微卷积/内积梯度回传 + Sinkhorn 双随机归一化，可在少量 Epoch 内同时获得高分类 F1 与高对比度概念激活图。

title: Post-hoc Concept Bottleneck Models
authors: Mert Yuksekgonul, Maggie Wang, James Zou
venue: ICLR 2023 / AAAI Workshop on Interpretable ML

verbatim_quotes.quote: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) map inputs to human-understandable concepts first, and then use these concepts to make predictions.
We project the backbone embeddings onto the subspace spanned by concept vectors, preserving both interpretability and expressive power.

title: Fast Log-Domain Sinkhorn Optimal Transport with Warp-Level GPU Reductions

verbatim_quotes.quote: Entropic regularized optimal transport (OT) via the Sinkhorn algorithm has become a fundamental tool in machine learning, yet existing implementations either suffer from numerical instability for small regularization parameters or incur significant overhead from deep learning frameworks.

We validate our solver on image color transfer, 3D point cloud matching, and convergence analysis, demonstrating that native CUDA kernels with careful numerical treatment provide a practical and efficient foundation for large-scale optimal transport computation.
